title: spiesia campestris
intro: Spiesia campestris, commonly known as Chinese angelica or dong quai, is a perennial plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). The health benefits of Spiesia campestris include its use in traditional Chinese medicine to treat menstrual disorders, anemia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, which contribute to its ability to regulate the immune system and promote overall health. The bioactive constituents of Spiesia campestris include ferulic acid, ligustilide, and butylphthalide, among others, which have been shown to have therapeutic effects.
